name: labinfo
description: Lab service directory: user-facing web/REST endpoint URLs (endpoints_list) and protocol-level connection details — hosts/ports, LDAP DNs, DNS zones, NFS mount options, SMTP settings, AAA secrets, SSO issuer/JWKS (connections_list) — of every lab service. Credentials included when the lab runs in dev mode. Use it to direct users to the right URL or to configure a client against a lab service.
